description: This Kotlin source file defines the ProgressChartPresenter class, responsible for rendering a mini bar chart visualization of the last 7 days' calorie data within an Android TV application. It creates and binds a custom ImageCardView with a generated bitmap that visually represents calorie entries as bars with labels and subtle axes, styled for TV readability.

classes.name: ProgressChartPresenter
classes.description: A custom Presenter for Android TV that renders a mini bar chart of calorie intake over the last seven days, styled with green bars and subtle axes for enhanced readability in TV environments.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes an ImageCardView with focus properties and set dimensions, title, content text, and background colors.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Generates a bitmap with a bar chart representing calorie entries, draws axes and labels, and binds this bitmap to the ImageCardView within the ViewHolder.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the bitmap image from the ImageCardView to free resources.
